description: Blue Lake is an upright bush bean with medium-thick green pods that are plump, tasty, and best when harvested at 15cm long. The plant has a high yield, long season, and benefits from inoculant.
sowing_method: Direct seed indoors or out. Transplant seedlings after hardening off.
